item.title: ICL Inaugurates State-of-the-Art Water-Soluble NPK Fertilizer Manufacturing Plant in Maharashtra
item.description: ICL has launched a state-of-the-art specialty fertilizer facility in Supa, Maharashtra. Supporting "Make in India," the plant utilizes advanced Israeli technology to produce water-soluble fertilizers, enhancing domestic supply and sustainability.

item.title: Best Agrolife adopts global MoA labelling as pest resistance concerns reshape agri-input usage
item.description: Best Agrolife Limited has introduced global Mode of Action (MoA) labelling across its portfolio to combat pest resistance, promote chemical rotation, and enhance sustainable crop protection through informed field decisions.

item.title: Samvardhana 2026: Albaugh India’s High-Stake Distributor Meet
item.description: Albaugh, LLC officially launched Albaugh India at Samvardhana 2026, bringing together global leadership and distributors to unveil new products, technologies, infrastructure plans, and long-term strategies for India’s agricultural sector.

item.title: New Delhi to Host Ground-breaking Global Conference on Women in Agri-Food Systems (GCWAS–2026)
item.description: New Delhi will host the Global Conference on Women in Agri-Food Systems (GCWAS–2026) from March 12–14, 2026 inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu, bringing global leaders together to advance women’s empowerment and gender inclusion in agriculture.

item.title: DSR can reduce water use by up to 35% and cut cultivation costs by ₹14,000/ha; FSII calls for wider adoption
item.description: The FSII advocates for Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) to tackle water scarcity and labor costs. DSR can reduce water use by 35% and expenses by ₹14,000/ha through innovative seed technologies.

item.title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi: Role of Direct Income Support in Strengthening Farm Households
item.description: The PM-KISAN scheme provides ₹6,000 annually via DBT to 11 crore+ farmers, reducing financial constraints and improving productivity. Despite administrative challenges, it remains a vital pillar for India’s rural economic security.

item.title: Debunking Pesticide Myths: CropLife India Calls for Evidence-Based Debate on Crop Protection
item.description: CropLife India’s new explainer counters pesticide misconceptions, highlighting India’s low usage rates and rigorous regulations. It emphasizes that science-based crop protection is vital for food security and farmer livelihoods.

item.title: "New Technologies crucial for Sustainable Nutrition”, aver experts during AMIFOST – 2026, at Amity
item.description: The 9th AMIFOST conference at Amity University explores bio-convergence and next-gen food systems. Experts emphasized MSME support, technological innovation, and sustainable practices to bolster global food resilience and nutrition.

item.title: Supply Disruptions, Cost Surge and Risk of Counterfeits: CropLife India Sounds Alarm
item.description: CropLife India warns West Asia conflict may raise pesticide costs by 20-25%, disrupt supplies, reduce capacity utilisation, and increase counterfeit risks, potentially impacting farmers, crop yields, industry earnings, and MSMEs.

item.title: Pusa Krishi, ICAR-IARI Successfully Hosts SAMARTH 2026 – Empowering the Incubators
item.description: Pusa Krishi ICAR-IARI hosted SAMARTH 2026, uniting incubators and partners to strengthen agri-startup ecosystems through collaboration, leadership insights, knowledge sharing, and innovation support, empowering scalable, farmer-centric solutions nationwide.

item.title: Food Security as Strategic Power: Rethinking Agriculture in India’s Security Framework
item.description: Food security is no longer just about feeding people. It is now central to national security. From supply chain risks to climate shocks, India’s resilience depends on its farms. Why agriculture must be treated as strategic infrastructure is a debate policymakers cannot ignore.

item.title: Gender Inclusivity Takes Centre Stage on World Water Day 2026 at ICAR-RCER, Patna
item.description: World Water Day 2026 was celebrated with great enthusiasm at ICAR–Research Complex for Eastern Region, Patna in collaboration with IWMI, New Delhi. The programme was organized on the theme “Water and Gender,” highlighting the importance of sustainable water management and the critical role of gender inclusivity in water resource utilization.

item.title: Mission 2047: MIONP 2026, Make India Organic, Natural &amp;amp; Profitable
item.description: India’s Next Agricultural Leap Must Be Sustainable—and Profitable As India advances towards Viksit Bharat @2047, agriculture is entering a decisive transition. The priority is no longer limited to increasing production, but to ensuring that growth is resource-efficient, climate-resilient, and economically viable for farmers.

item.title: International Workshop on Accelerating SDG Delivery through Stronger Governance
item.description: The two-day workshop in New Delhi convened policymakers from various nations for peer learning and action-oriented strategies.

item.title: Furniture Stores in Gurgaon or Furniture Stores in Delhi: Where Do Urban Buyers Shop?
item.description: You have been putting this off for weeks. The old sofa is not getting any better. The dining table wobbles every time someone leans on it. You know you need to go furniture shopping. You just have not decided where yet.
